messages:
rita: Heads-up: planning to enable seraph-v1 in the model catalog during tonight's 23:00-00:30 UTC change window. Need final confirmation on fallback order, canary route pin (webhook-prod), and exact rollback triggers.
cory: Canary suggestion: start ap-southeast region only at 3% for 10m, then 15% for 20m if metrics OK. Keep global default unchanged.
lee: Perf note: seraph baseline latency ~+12% at 2048 context in our perf harness. Memory similar to nebula-13b. Recommend keeping quantized variant first in fallback to protect cost.
eva: Quality gate: run eval suite eval/seraph_prodset_2026 and fail if semantic-match delta > 0.8% or hallucination rate increases > 0.3%. Also add a human spot-check step after 15m.
rita: Proposed rollback criteria: p95 latency > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR 5xx rate > 0.2% for 5m OR eval regression > thresholds above. Agree?
lee: Agree. Also immediate rollback on any OOM or worker crash loops.
cory: Fallback ordering request: [seraph-8q, seraph-v1, nebula-13b, legacy-11b]. Make sure the 8q artifact is already uploaded to registry.
eva: I'll kick the eval job 30m before window and post results. If regressions appear, abort enable.
sre-oncall: I will wire up alerts in pagerduty: p95-latency-seraph, error-rate-seraph, queue-depth-seraph. Escalation policy: page infra if queue_depth > 100 for 3m.
deploy-bot: catalog.enable queued by rita for seraph-v1. Change window: 23:00 UTC. Canary policy: ap-southeast:3%->15%. Fallback ordering to be set to [seraph-8q, seraph-v1, nebula-13b, legacy-11b]. Route pin: webhook-prod -> seraph@v1 (canary only).
rita: Checklist: 1) verify 8q artifact existence, 2) run eval, 3) update catalog entry with fallback array, 4) create canary route and pin, 5) start canary, 6) monitor and human spot-check, 7) promote or rollback.
lee: I pushed a quick check: registry://models/seraph/8q exists and checksum matches.
eva: eval done preflight: semantic delta 0.12% (ok), hallucination +0.05% (ok). Uploading results to rollouts tab.
deploy-bot: canary started for seraph-v1 at 5321234000 on route webhook-prod (3% ap-southeast). Monitoring hooks: telemetry/seraph-canary, alerts: p95-latency, error-rate, eval-regression.
rita: Monitoring green at 8m. Human spot-check passed 3/3. Moving to 15% after 10m.
sre-oncall: Watching. Created dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/seraph-canary
cory: Small latency blip at minute 9 but p95 within limits. No action.
deploy-bot: canary update applied: 15% at 5321234300.
lee: Noting a tiny memory bump but below threshold. Still observing.
eva: Eval post-15m: semantic delta 0.2%, hallucination 0.08% (both within limits). Logging pass.
rita: If we stay green for 30m, schedule global canary pin to production default at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Monica (prod owner) will approve final promo.
cory: For rollback steps: 1) deploy-bot revert canary route and unpin webhook-prod, 2) restore previous fallback ordering, 3) open short incident, 4) tag rollback in changelog.
sre-oncall: Agreed. I will prepare a runbook snippet for rollback.
deploy-bot: canary stable at 15% as of 5321234500.
rita: Release notes draft: "seraph: canary enable v1. Preferred fallback: quantized 8q. Quality and latency gates applied. Route webhook-prod pinned for canary only." I'll PR changelog now.
eva: PR created: github.com/redwood/changelogs/pull/342.
lee: ack. Leaving canary pinned overnight, will not modify global default until morning sign-off.
rita: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if alerts or evals trigger. :white_check_mark:
